# castai_organization_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single group in a Cast AI organization by its exact, case-sensitive name. Useful for resolving SCIM-synced group UUIDs for castai_role_bindings without hardcoding them. The data source errors if no group with the given name exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a group by its exact, case-sensitive name. Groups synced from an
# identity provider (SCIM) never enter Terraform state, so the data source
# resolves their UUIDs without hardcoding. It errors when the name matches
# nothing or more than one group.
data "castai_organization_group" "platform" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "platform-engineers"
}

# Bind the group to a role; the resolved id is the group subject.
resource "castai_role_bindings" "platform_viewer" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "platform-viewer"
  role_id         = var.viewer_role_id

  scopes {
    kind        = "organization"
    resource_id = var.organization_id
  }

  subjects {
    subject {
      kind     = "group"
      group_id = data.castai_organization_group.platform.id
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive name of the group to look up.
- `organization_id` (String) Cast AI organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `id` (String) Group UUID, e.g. to reference a subject in castai_role_bindings.
- `managed_by` (String) How the group is managed: console, terraform, idp-sync or sso-default; empty for legacy groups.
- `sso_provider` (String) SSO connection that owns the group, when the group is provisioned by SSO/SCIM.
